statement: Accepted canonical motif compression supplies finite source and compressed motif objects.
assumptions: W finite;canonical motif M accepted;M_comp selected
conclusion: M and M_comp are comparable motif objects
missing_hypothesis: global motif completeness outside accepted compression

statement: Motif payload roles rewrite/refine through the accepted compressed motif.
assumptions: payload-role compatibility in accepted motif compression
conclusion: compressed payload carrier is well-defined up to normalization
missing_hypothesis: layerwise payload refinement through motif normalization

statement: Source and compressed status domains are compatible only when status dependencies rewrite/refine across M->M_comp.
conclusion: W and W_comp status domains comparable

statement: Motif compression followed by normalization preserves the normal form required by status semantics.
Payload congruence plus domain and normal-form transfer imply status congruence only if the status predicate is determined by those data.
missing_hypothesis: status predicate determination theorem for motif compression

statement: Canonical motif compression preserves counterexample status under refined congruence.
If compression changes status domain but W_comp is a valid reduced counterexample, lexicographic decrease gives a smaller witness.
assumptions: accepted compression decreases measure;W_comp valid reduced obstruction

statement: If refined congruence fails, compression status does not silently succeed.
conclusion: named blocker or deferred higher-support escape
missing_hypothesis: higher-support bound after operation proofs close

statement: Canonical motif congruence is payload-ready but status-domain/normal-form/status-predicate open.
